audit_objective: Validation of Student-Level Intervention Aggregation & Leakage Elimination

peak_risk_aggregation_audit.methodology: P_s = max_a prob(s, a) across all semester assessments
peak_risk_aggregation_audit.positive_label_definition: Student failed AT LEAST ONE assessment across entire course lifespan
peak_risk_aggregation_audit.root_cause_of_96pct_precision: Precision reaches 96.27% at top 10% because: (1) base rate was inflated to 33.49% by crediting a positive label if the student failed ANY assessment at ANY time; (2) students with multiple attempts had multiple chances for peak risk; and (3) 33.5% of students in top 10% did not fail the peak-risk assessment, but were credited as true positives because they failed another assessment.

leakage_free_alternative_A_first_assessm.methodology: First-Assessment Milestone (Assessment 1 per unique student evaluated 7d prior)

leakage_free_alternative_B_day30_cutoff.methodology: Common Calendar Cutoff at Day 30 (Next upcoming assessment scheduled after Day 30)
leakage_free_alternative_B_day30_cutoff.positive_label_definition: Student score < 50 on next upcoming assessment after Day 30
